requirements.title: ENDFILE explicitly writes an endfile record
requirements.definition: An endfile record is written explicitly by an ENDFILE statement.
requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

S12.2.4-001 I/O records/files runtime fixtures: after a sequential formatted data record, ENDFILE is executed explicitly; REWIND then reads the data record first and the next READ returns the named intrinsic IOSTAT_END value, not a processor-specific number.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself requires rejection and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. IOMSG wording and processor-dependent numeric status values are never an oracle.

S12.2.4-001 I/O records/files fixture boundaries: These fixtures are single-image positive runtime observations over internal CHARACTER files, scratch external files, and conservative local named files created in the execution working directory and deleted by the program. They assert only exact integers/logicals/characters, LEN before character equality, IOSTAT zero, and equality with the named IOSTAT_END constant. They do not assert byte sizes, record marker layout, IOMSG text, numeric IOSTAT values, ambient file existence, path syntax beyond the chosen local names, preconnected file identity, coarray image interactions, stream/record correspondence, or required diagnostics for mismatched forms/nonexistent files. Remaining facets stay pending with their source-accounting rationale.

requirements.title: Explicit ENDFILE requires sequential access connection
requirements.definition: For explicit endfile record writing, the file shall be connected for sequential access.

pending.explicit-endfile-requires-sequential-acc: This unnumbered shall restriction is not discharged by a sequential positive control; direct/stream ENDFILE rejection is not required by this catalogue alone.

requirements.title: Certain positioning or close/open actions implicitly write an endfile record after output
requirements.definition: An endfile record is written implicitly to a sequential file when the most recent data transfer for the file is output, no intervening file-positioning statement for the file has executed, and either REWIND or BACKSPACE references the connected unit or the unit is closed explicitly, by normal termination, or by another OPEN for the same unit.

requirements.title: An endfile record occurs only as the last record of a file
requirements.definition: An endfile record shall occur only as the last record of a file.
